highlights.title: AI Safety Fears Grow After Multiple Breaches
highlights.description: The infiltration of Hugging Face by OpenAI's agents has put AI-enabled cyber attacks into the spotlight. The incident and similar breaches reported by Anthropic PBC and Meta Platforms Inc. have fueled calls in Washington and Silicon Valley for more thorough safety reviews of artificial intelligence models. Bloomberg's Jordan Robertson reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

highlights.title: Sony, TSMC to Invest $6.4 Billion in Japanese Sensor Plant
highlights.description: Sony Group Corp. and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. are in talks to spend a combined ¥1 trillion ($6.4 billion) on their planned image sensor factory in Japan, according to a person familiar with the matter.

highlights.title: TSMC Sales Rise 45% as Demand for AI Hardware Stays Strong
highlights.description: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. reported a 45% rise in its monthly sales, a sign of sustained demand for AI hardware in the face of market volatility.

highlights.title: China Humanoid Makers Hold 97% of Global Shipments, Report Says
highlights.description: China’s humanoid robot makers commanded more than 97% of global shipments in the first half of 2026, according to new industry data affirming the country’s early lead against US rivals in the burgeoning field.

highlights.title: DeepX CEO on Business Strategy, New Funding
highlights.description: Lokwon Kim, Founder and CEO at DeepX, discusses the chip designer's business strategy and latest funding. He speaks with Shery Ahn on Bloomberg: The Asia Trade. (Source: Bloomberg)

highlights.title: Inside stablecoin firm BVNK’s journey to a $1.8B acquisition by Mastercard
highlights.description: Early BVNK investor Concentric shares a fascinating inside view on the stablecoin startup’s journey and the eventual Mastercard deal.
